nom: Urban Veda Soothing Ayurvedic Sandalwood & Botanics Exfoliating Facial Polish

avis.texte: Lovely face polish that gently exfoliates and leaves my skin feeling smooth, soft, and refreshed. It hydrates well so my skin doesn't feel dry, and the light citrus and lavender scent makes it feel like a mini spa treatment. My skin looks brighter and more radiant after using it.
Very pleased with this product. The smell is very soothing and the grit is not too strong for sensitive skin.

This is my new favorite product. The scent is amazing and makes me feel like i am in a spa. I feel also feels cleansing and soothing at the same time and afterwards i also felt like i had recieved a facial. Im in love with this and looking forward to using other products by urban veda
Lovely product bought following receipt of a free sample. Great way to introduce new items, I'd likely never have bought it otherwise. Makes skin feel smooth and glow

The product performs well, has a nice texture, and is a really nice gentle scrub, especially for the price point, but the fragrance is so overwhelmingly strong. I'm not even particularly sensitive to smells, but this is like putting perfume on my face.

I came across this by chance when I was looking for an exfoliator and my mom mentioned she'd just bought this and that I could try it. SO glad I did, my face is beyond smooth and soft, which I need during the harsh winter. Very light on sensitive skin and not too expensive either!
This has been great so far, leaves my skin feeling soft and not dry at all. If you're looking for a gentle natural exfoliant this is the one.
I have very sensitive, combination skin and this brightens and is gentle yet effective. It also smells amazing! I wont use anything else!

avis.titre: Makes your face feel super clean
avis.texte: Really like this product, it's gentle enough to use multiple times per week but makes your face feel so smooth. I thought it was going to be too gentle but works much better than other similar exfoliating cleansers that I've tried.

I've only used this product twice so i can't say i've seen a major difference but my face has been so dry the passed few weeks and I can tell it has added a slight natural glow to my face. It also has made my face super soft even my boyfriend noticed! I do have fairly sensitive skin even "sensitive" products tend to break me out so we will see. Fingers crossed!
Really nice texture, smells very calming. Good if you like natural.

avis.titre: Very nice and gentle on skin
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin and this is a game changer for me. The granuales are small and I really feel that my skin is clean and soft. I love the aroma to.

avis.titre: Best face polish for sensitive skin. Highly recommend.
avis.texte: This exfoliating polish is one that I would prefer. Gentle enough to use multiple times a week. After rinsing, the skin feels smooth and glowing. Works great on my sensitive skin.

I got a sample of this a few months ago and loved it so bought the full size and it still doesn't disappoint! I have dry skin and this exfoliator is really cleansing but also moisturising as it is creamy with exfoliating particles. It also smells DIVINE!!! love it. Bought the Soothing Day Cream and Facial Oil too!

This is exfoliating but there is nothing soothing about it. The particles and the fragrance are irritating to sensitive skin. It definitely does a good job exfoliating but I prefer Clinique 7 day scrub which is a lot gentler and which I am going back to after this.

This scrub isn't like a traditional one, it really is a polish. It has very fine scrubby bits in it but is a cream texture instead of gel. When I first opened it I was surprised to see it wasn't a gel like I'm used to but I like the cream so much better for my sensitive skin. I can't use very harsh products as I will get red and irritated but this isn't too harsh and I find the consistency is much gentler while still helping me get rid of dead skin.

avis.titre: After just ONE use the effects are visible!
avis.texte: I've just tried a free sample of this that I received with an online order. This is the first time I've used Urban Veda but I'm seriously impressed with the product. After just ONE use the effects are visible! My skin is smooth, clean and smells beautiful! I'd recommend this product and I'll definitely be checking out the rest of the range.
This is the only scrub I can use on my face which doesn't cause me to get dry skin, which ends up with impetigo. Would 100% recommend for someone with dry sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Nice, suitable product for everyday use.
avis.texte: I bought this as I use the facial wash (which is beautiful). This is a very subtle scrub that I use most days (I had a bit of a hormonal breakout that left my skin dry). Love the fragrance of this and it is very good value for money as a little goes a long way. Very effective.

This is possibly the best facial scrub I have used in many years! It is every bit as soothing as it says in the name and the smell is simply divine! I am so pleased i bought this product and even more so, as it was on offer. This will definitely have a permanent place in my beauty regime.

This facial polish is my holy grail. After using the same products for a good few years I noticed that something changed & my skin was going flaky & really dry. My mum actually recommended that I try something from Urban Veda so I bought this & im so glad that I did! It's so gentle yet you can feel how clean it leaves your face. My redness has dramatically improved & I am no longer flaky or dry!
Gentle facial scrub with nice and not annoying smell. Will definitely buy again.

Love the smell of Sandalwood and Ylang Ylang, and I have sensitive skin, so when I saw this wash I had to try it. Have only used it a couple of times, so far, and I'm very happy with how it feels and smells. Because it feels and smells so nice, it feels special (which might sound silly to some), makes you feel good, and to me that's a good way to start the day.

avis.titre: Bubbly, deep cleansing, but very gentle
avis.texte: Refreshing and soothing upon my delicate skin. I usually hesitate when it comes to choosing a facial wash due to my skin being combination and very sensitive, but this product made my face feel enriched as well as deeply cleansed. I noticed the overall condition and quality of my skin looked visibly better, and the usual small areas of eczema had improved and didn't look red or irritated after use. It's kind to your skin, smells lovely, it isn't over powering or astringent and a little goes a long way due to its thick consistency. I love this brand and I love this range of items.
